stages.name: Reading for gist

stages.name: Reading for detail
stages.todo: The rest of Exercise 2b. Pairs compare, then take it to the class and ask what Magda actually said about each.

stages.name: Focus on the question words
stages.todo: Exercise 3a, the matching. Then the book’s point: what when the possible answers are many, which when they are few; what kind of before a singular noun, what kinds of before a plural. Drill the question words.

stages.name: Post-reading
stages.todo: Exercise 3b — Diego’s answers matched to the same questions — then 3c, six questions of their choice asked to a partner. Magda’s post is also the exposure for the questions lesson after you.

stages.todo: The Grammar bank exercises, one worked on the board first, then alone and checked in pairs.

stages.name: Lead-in
stages.todo: Use the Test – Teach – Test framework, or another shape if you prefer. Check the workbook for practice and think about the freer task. Language analysis: six words. Open the topic, not the language. They should not know yet which words you are after.

stages.name: First test — the diagnostic
stages.todo: The word web on the page, done in pairs with no help from you. This stage is NOT teaching and nothing is corrected in it — its only job is to show you which of the six verbs on page 48 they already have. Move round and write down what is missing and what is wrong; that list IS your next stage.
stages.avoid: Do not pre-teach before the first test, and do not correct during it. A test the students pass because you helped them tells you nothing.

stages.name: Teach — meaning, form, pronunciation
stages.todo: Clarify ONLY what the test exposed. Anything they got right is not taught again — that is the whole point of the shape and the thing candidates get wrong. Meaning first, then form, then drill.

stages.name: Second test
stages.todo: The same ground again, in a new task, so they and you can see what has changed. It has to be comparable with the first test or the shape proves nothing.

stages.name: Freer practice
stages.todo: They use the words for something real. The workbook has controlled practice if you would rather spend the time there.
